name: mongolian-chess-analysis
description: AI-native Mongolian chess analysis platform monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mda-chess/shared && npm run build -w @mda-chess/ui && npm run build -w @mda-chess/chess-engine && npm run build -w @mda-chess/api-client && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/mobile
